u0: No outstanding response is currently pending: there is no active siren, unhandled client arrival, prepared delivery, or dropped-food recovery. Keep watching for the siren and for clients; take orders, fetch and prepare food, recover dropped food immediately, and serve only while the siren is silent.
u1: The siren is ringing and the switch still needs to be turned off. No other active client or food obligation is present. While it rings, prepared food must not be handed to a client.
u10: An order has been taken and food has slipped, while the siren is ringing. Regain the food on the next move, prepare it, and switch the siren off before serving. The order cannot be served while the siren is still ringing.
u11: Prepared food has slipped and must be recovered on the very next step. After it is back in hand, serve it to the waiting client with the siren silent. If a ring begins before service, it must be turned off first.
u12: Prepared food has slipped while the siren is ringing. Pick the food up on the next move and turn the siren off before serving. Then deliver the prepared order.
u13: A client has arrived and is waiting, but the order has not yet been taken. Take the order, fetch food from the pantry, prepare it, and serve it with the siren silent.
u14: A client has arrived and the siren is ringing. Switch the siren off and take the order, then fetch and prepare food and serve it only after the siren is silent.
u15: A client has arrived and still needs to have their order taken, while a prepared portion is waiting to be served. Take the order, then deliver the prepared food, making sure the siren is silent at service. If the prepared food is not in hand, retrieve it first.
u16: A client still needs to have their order taken, prepared food is ready to be served, and the siren is ringing. Switch off the siren, take the order, and then serve the prepared food. Service must wait until the siren is silent.
u17: A client has arrived and food has slipped from the agent's hands. Pick the food up on the very next move, then take the order, prepare the food, and serve it with the siren silent.
u18: A client has arrived, food has slipped, and the siren is ringing. Regain the food on the next move, take the order, prepare the food, and switch the siren off before serving.
u19: A client has arrived and still needs their order taken, and prepared food has slipped and must be recovered on the very next step. After recovering it, take the order and serve the prepared food with the siren silent. If a ring starts before service, turn it off first.
u2: A mandatory rule has been broken beyond repair, for example by serving an order while the siren was still ringing. Successful completion is no longer possible; later actions cannot undo the violation.
u20: A client has arrived and is waiting for their order to be taken, and prepared food is waiting to be served. The siren is ringing and must be switched off; because serving while the siren rings is forbidden, silence the siren before serving the prepared food. Food has just slipped and must be picked up on the very next move, so attend to that pickup first.
u21: A client has arrived and is waiting for their order to be taken, and an order has already been taken whose food still needs to be prepared at the stove. Both tasks remain, and they can be handled in either order. Preparing requires holding raw food and a client whose order is taken.
u22: A client is waiting for their order to be taken, and an order has been taken whose food needs preparation at the stove. The siren is ringing and must be switched off. These tasks can be done in any order, but the siren must be silent before any future serving.
u23: A client is waiting for their order to be taken, and an order awaits preparation at the stove. Food has just slipped and must be picked up on the very next move; this pickup is urgent and should be done before anything else. Afterward, take the waiting order and prepare the food.
u24: A client is waiting for their order to be taken, and an order awaits preparation. Food has just slipped and must be picked up on the next move, so do that first. The siren is also ringing and must be switched off; it must be silent before any future serving.
u25: An order has been taken and its food still needs to be prepared at the stove, while prepared food is also waiting to be served. Both tasks remain and can be done in either order. Preparing requires holding raw food and a client whose order is taken; serving requires carrying prepared food and facing the client.
u26: An order awaits preparation at the stove, and prepared food awaits serving. The siren is ringing and must be switched off; silence it before serving the prepared food. Preparing can be done while the siren rings.
u27: An order awaits preparation, and prepared food awaits serving. Food has just slipped and must be picked up on the very next move; do that pickup first. Then prepare the order and serve the prepared food.
u28: Food has just slipped and must be picked up on the next move. Also outstanding: an order needs preparation, prepared food needs serving, and the siren is ringing. After the pickup, switch off the siren before serving the prepared food; preparing the order can be done regardless.
u29: A client has arrived and is waiting for their order to be taken, an order awaits preparation, and prepared food awaits serving. All three tasks remain and can be handled in any order. The siren is currently silent, but it must be silent whenever the prepared food is served.
u3: A client's order has been taken and the client is waiting for food. The food still needs to be prepared and served; if the agent is not already carrying a portion, it must fetch one first. The siren must be silent at the moment of serving.
u30: A client is waiting for their order to be taken, an order awaits preparation, prepared food awaits serving, and the siren is ringing. The siren must be switched off before the prepared food can be served. The other tasks can proceed while the siren rings.
u31: A client is waiting for their order to be taken, an order awaits preparation, prepared food awaits serving, and food has just slipped. Pick up the fallen food on the very next move. After that, take the waiting order, prepare the food, and serve the prepared food.
u32: Food has just slipped and must be picked up on the next move. Also outstanding: a client waiting for their order to be taken, an order needing preparation, prepared food waiting to be served, and the ringing siren. After the pickup, switch off the siren before serving the prepared food; the other tasks can be done in any order.
u4: An order has been taken while the siren is ringing. The siren must be switched off, and the food still needs to be fetched, prepared, and served. Serving is only allowed after the siren is silent.
u5: Food has been prepared and still needs to be served to the waiting client. If it is not in hand, it must be retrieved first, and a slip would require picking it up on the next move. The siren must be silent when the food is handed over.
u6: Prepared food is ready, but the siren is ringing. Switch the siren off before serving; handing over food while it rings would break a mandatory rule. After silence, deliver the prepared order.
u7: Food has slipped out of the agent's hands and must be picked up on the very next step. If it is not regained immediately, a mandatory rule is broken for good. Once it is back in hand, no other food-recovery task is outstanding.
u8: Food has slipped while the siren is ringing. The food must be picked up on the next move without delay; the siren also needs to be switched off, but recovering the food has the immediate deadline. Do not serve anything while the siren remains on.
u9: An order has been taken, and food has slipped from the agent's hands. The food must be regained on the very next step, then prepared and served to the waiting client. The siren must be off when the order is served.
